# runpod_pod (Data Source)

A single pod looked up by identifier. Reports everything the API returns for the pod, including the live cost, runtime utilization, SSH details, mounts, and cluster membership that the runpod_pod resource does not manage.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_pod" "training" {
  id = "pod_abc123"
}

output "hourly_cost" {
  description = "What the pod costs per hour right now, in USD."
  value       = data.runpod_pod.training.cost
}

output "ssh_command" {
  description = "Proxy SSH command; null until the pod has a machine assignment."
  value       = try(data.runpod_pod.training.ssh.proxy.command, null)
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Pod identifier, e.g. "pod_abc123".

### Read-Only

- `actions` (List of String) State transitions the pod accepts in its current status.
- `args` (String) Arguments passed to the container entrypoint.
- `cloud` (String) Cloud tier: SECURE or COMMUNITY.
- `cluster` (Attributes) Cluster membership; null for a standalone pod. Member pods are managed through the cluster, not the pod endpoints. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cluster))
- `cost` (Number) Current cost in USD per hour; 0 while the pod is EXITED or TERMINATED.
- `cpu_memory` (Number) Memory in GB allocated to a CPU pod; null for a GPU pod.
- `cpu_type_id` (String) CPU flavor identifier; null for a GPU pod.
- `cpu_vcpu_count` (Number) vCPU count allocated to a CPU pod; null for a GPU pod.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `cuda_version` (String) CUDA version reported by the host machine; null for CPU pods and for hosts that report none.
- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the pod runs in.
- `disk` (Number) Container disk in GB (ephemeral).
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables set in the container.
- `global_networking` (Boolean) Whether global networking is enabled, giving the pod a private IP reachable across data centers.
- `global_networking_internal_dns` (String) Internal DNS name reachable from other globally-networked pods in the account; null unless global networking is enabled.
- `global_networking_ip` (String) Global-networking IP; null unless global networking is enabled.
- `gpu_count` (Number) Number of GPUs attached; null for a CPU pod.
- `gpu_memory` (Number) System RAM in GB across all requested GPUs; null for a CPU pod.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type identifier; null for a CPU pod.
- `gpu_vcpu_count` (Number) vCPU count across all requested GPUs; null for a CPU pod.
- `image` (String) Docker image reference.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the pod is locked, which blocks stopping and resetting it.
- `mounts` (Attributes) Storage mounted into the pod. At most one of persistent or network is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mounts))
- `name` (String) Pod display name.
- `ports` (List of String) Exposed ports, formatted as port/protocol.
- `registry` (String) Registry credential ID used to pull the image; null for public images.
- `runtime` (Attributes) Live utilization metrics; null unless the pod is RUNNING. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtime))
- `ssh` (Attributes) How to reach the pod over SSH. Both variants authenticate with the account's registered SSH public keys, which only reach a pod created with SSH provisioning enabled. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh))
- `started_at` (String) Timestamp of the pod's last start in RFC 3339 format; null until it has started.
- `status` (String) Pod lifecycle status: PROVISIONING, STARTING, RUNNING, EXITED, ERROR, or TERMINATED.
- `template` (String) Identifier of the template the pod was created from; null when it was created without one.

<a id="nestedatt--cluster"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cluster`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the cluster the pod belongs to.
- `ip` (String) Address on the cluster's private overlay network; null until assigned.
- `rank` (Number) Node rank within the cluster; rank 0 is the entry node. Null until assigned.
- `role` (String) SLURM or RAY role; null for TRAINING and APPLICATION clusters, which assign no roles.


<a id="nestedatt--mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mounts`

Read-Only:

- `network` (Attributes List) Network volumes mounted into the pod; empty when the pod has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mounts--network))
- `persistent` (Attributes) Host-local persistent storage, pinned to the pod's host machine; null when the pod has no persistent mount. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mounts--persistent))

<a id="nestedatt--mounts--network"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mounts.network`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Mount path inside the container.
- `volume_id` (String) Identifier of the mounted network volume.


<a id="nestedatt--mounts--persistent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mounts.persistent`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Mount path inside the container.
- `size` (Number) Allocated storage in GB.



<a id="nestedatt--runtime"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime`

Read-Only:

- `cpu_util` (Number) CPU utilization percentage, 0 to 100.
- `gpus` (Attributes List) One entry per attached GPU. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtime--gpus))
- `memory_util` (Number) Memory utilization percentage, 0 to 100.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Port mappings assigned to the running pod. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--runtime--ports))
- `uptime_seconds` (Number) Seconds since the container started.

<a id="nestedatt--runtime--gpus"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime.gpus`

Read-Only:

- `memory_util` (Number) GPU memory utilization percentage, 0 to 100.
- `util` (Number) GPU utilization percentage, 0 to 100.


<a id="nestedatt--runtime--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `runtime.ports`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Address the port is reachable on.
- `private_port` (Number) Port inside the container.
- `public_port` (Number) Port published outside the container.
- `type` (String) Protocol of the mapping, e.g. http or tcp.



<a id="nestedatt--ssh"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh`

Read-Only:

- `direct` (Attributes) Connection straight to the pod's sshd over its published 22/tcp mapping, with the full SSH feature set. Null unless 22/tcp is exposed and the running pod has a public port for it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh--direct))
- `proxy` (Attributes) Connection through the Runpod SSH proxy: interactive shell only, no port forwarding or file copy. Null until the pod has a machine assignment. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssh--proxy))

<a id="nestedatt--ssh--direct"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh.direct`

Read-Only:

- `command` (String) Ready-to-run ssh command for the direct connection.
- `host` (String) Host to connect to.
- `port` (Number) TCP port to connect to.
- `username` (String) SSH user name.


<a id="nestedatt--ssh--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ssh.proxy`

Read-Only:

- `command` (String) Ready-to-run ssh command for the proxy connection.
- `host` (String) Host to connect to.
- `port` (Number) TCP port to connect to.
- `username` (String) SSH user name.
